name: WinMind
summary:
WinMind is a single player, freeware version of the classic, code breaking game Mastermind.

Game-play is virtually identical to all other Mastermind clones, the player has to deduce the correct five colour code and has twelve attempts to accomplish this. In response to each guess the player is told how many colours in the right position and how many colours in the wrong position were present in the attempt.

The game has three difficulty levels and can be played by the keyboard or the mouse.
